description: Patentability check / patent triage v0. Carves an invention into its smallest spring (one-sentence independent claim) + named failure modes; searches a prior-art corpus for nearest-neighbor matches and aggregates a novelty-verdict; refines the claim under smallest-spring discipline given the novelty-verdict; judges GO / NO-GO / NEEDS-WORK with optional provisional-draft. Methodology-lane slice — subhuti + groove add their slices in follow-ups.

phases.name: carve
phases.intent: Diverge → carve. From the invention-spec, extract the smallest-spring one-sentence carved claim + enumerate ≥3 named failure modes with bounds + enumerate ≥5 apoha-distinctions (what this is NOT relative to prior art). Outputs: claim-draft + failure-modes.

phases.name: search-novelty
phases.intent: Diverge → sense. Search a prior-art corpus (patents + literature) for nearest-neighbor matches to the carved claim; report hits with similarity scores; aggregate into a novelty-verdict (PASS / FAIL / TOO-CLOSE-TO-CALL). Outputs: prior-art-hit (list) + novelty-verdict.

phases.name: refine-claim
phases.intent: Converge → reshape. Rewrite the claim to maximize defensible scope given the novelty-verdict; enforce smallest-spring discipline (one independent claim, ≤3 dependent claims, no `comprising` chains over 3 elements). Output: refined claim-draft.

phases.name: judge
phases.intent: Converge → verdict. Produce the final GO / NO-GO / NEEDS-WORK verdict with named axis-of-failure if NEEDS-WORK. If verdict is GO, also produce a provisional-draft artifact. Outputs: triage-verdict (always) + provisional-draft (GO only).
